text: Orbit is the path that a planet or celestial body follows around its sun or other massive object. Craters are natural features on the surface of a planet or celestial body that have been eroded by the force of weathering and erosion. It is important to note that the term "orbit" is used differently in astronomy compared to other fields of science, as it is a term used to describe the path a planet or celestial body takes around a star or other massive object.
